Are you a Midwife looking for a rewarding career opportunity in Sweden?
We are currently recruiting Midwives to join well-established antenatal care clinics in central Sweden. This is an opportunity to work in a supportive and patient-centered environment focused on pregnancy care, reproductive health, preventive healthcare, and women's wellbeing. 
You will become part of a dedicated team working closely with fellow Midwives and other healthcare professionals to provide high-quality care for women and families throughout pregnancy.
About the role
As a Midwife, you will work within antenatal care, providing support and guidance to women throughout pregnancy and reproductive life.
Your responsibilities may include:
Antenatal care and routine pregnancy follow-up
Health assessments and pregnancy monitoring
Patient education and counselling
Reproductive and sexual health consultations
Cervical screening
Preventive healthcare and health promotion
Supporting women and families throughout pregnancy
Collaboration with women's healthcare, primary care, and family health services

Hold a valid Midwife license issued in an EU/EEA country
Good English language skills
Motivation to learn Swedish
Motivation to relocate and work in Sweden on a long-term basis

Meritorious
Experience within antenatal care

Knowledge of Swedish or another Scandinavian language

Responsible and professional

jobs.occupation: General nurses wanted for permanent positions in Norway
jobs.description:
Are you a qualified general nurse looking for professional growth and new life experiences?
We offer numerous exciting opportunities for nurses who are interested in moving to Norway, a country known for its high-quality healthcare system, balanced work-life culture and beautiful natural landscapes.
Your role:
Providing holistic care to patients, addressing their medical, hygienic and social needs.
Monitoring patients’ vital signs and keeping records of their health progress.
Administering medications and treatments as prescribed by doctors.
Performing blood draws and other routine medical procedures.
Collaborating with a multidisciplinary team to deliver optimal care.
Offering emotional support and clear communication to patients and their families.
Working in both hospital and home care settings, adapting to each patient’s individual needs.

Qualifications:
Hold a valid nursing authorization from an EU country.
Have previous work experience as a nurse, with a preference for those who have experience in hospitals or community care settings.
Be proficient with basic computer skills, necessary for modern healthcare environments.
Speak and write English fluently. Candidates must also be motivated to learn Norwegian.
Hold a bachelor’s degree in nursing (BSN).
A driver’s license may be required for certain home care positions.

Personal qualities:
Strong communication skills and the ability to work well in a team-oriented environment.
A responsible, structured, and flexible approach to patient care.
The ability to remain calm and perform under pressure, handling stressful situations with a professional attitude.
Respect for patients’ individual needs and a compassionate approach to their care.
A strong desire to move to Norway and integrate into Norwegian society, bringing your family along for a rewarding experience.
A genuine passion for nursing, combined with a clear understanding of your professional responsibilities and limitations.
The ability to prioritize tasks and maintain a solution-oriented mindset.

What we offer:
Competitive salary packages and pension plans.
A permanent employment opportunity in a supportive and friendly environment.
A clear path for professional growth and development.
Free online Norwegian language courses with a private tutor to ease your transition.
Full assistance with obtaining Norwegian nursing authorization.
Comprehensive support with relocation logistics, including help with accommodation, schools, and childcare for your family.
Guidance from professional headhunters with 19 years of experience, who will assist you throughout the entire process.

Why choose Norway?
Norway is consistently ranked as one of the best countries in the world for quality of life. Our healthcare system is publicly funded, providing patients with excellent care while offering healthcare professionals a structured and rewarding work environment. 
Nurses in Norway benefit from clear career progression, strong support from interdisciplinary teams, and the ability to spend quality time with each patient, contributing to better health outcomes. In addition to professional growth, moving to Norway offers a chance to experience a high standard of living, with clean air, a focus on outdoor activities and a family-friendly environment.
If you see yourself thriving in this role and want to explore the possibilities of working in Norway, we encourage you to contact us. We look forward to guiding you through the next steps in your journey!

jobs.occupation: Internship in Refrigeration Circuit Engineering Department
jobs.description:
Company Description
Bosch Thermotechnology AB in Tranås develops, manufactures, and sells advanced heat pumps that harness energy from nature’s own resources – rock, water, and air.
In Tranås, you’ll find both our production unit and our competence and development center, where we constantly strive to stay at the forefront. Here we create smart solutions that simplify everyday life, contribute to a greener future, and provide our customers with safety and comfort

We believe in technology that makes a difference – technology that is Invented for life.

Job Description
Your contribution to something big
As part of this internship, you will engage in a diverse range of tasks, including:
Improving products by testing prototypes and/or serial appliances
Taking responsibility and contributing by coordinating project related topics
Supporting the team and development projects with analytical studies or simulations
Spreading and conserving knowledge by presenting and documenting test results or project findings
Involving yourself in research by studying and assessing new development ideas
Being creative and preparing or participating in development project related workshops

Duration of the internship: 6 months, preferably starting in March 2027
Location: on-site in our plant in Tranås, Sweden

Qualifications
What distinguishes you
Currently studying Mechanical Engineering or equivalent in the Bachelor's or Master's
Good written and verbal communication skills in English
Willingness to take on responsibility and drive work within your own initiative
Effective communication, teamwork abilities and comfortable working in an international team environment
Eagerness to learn and grow outside your field of studies
Strong logical reasoning and attention to detail
Critical thinking to analyze complex problems and dependencies
Knowledge in thermodynamics, fluid mechanics and refrigeration
Able to write engineering grade technical documentation
Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Visio, and Project)
Basic knowledge of Matlab/Simulink is an advantage

Additional Information
What we offer you
We offer monetary compensation to support you during your internship.
Free accommodation in Tranås is provided
To support your well-being, we provide a wellness contribution for use on fitness, sports, or wellness services
We cover your travel costs from your residence to Tranås, making relocation easier for you
You gain valuable experience working within an international company with global connections

Welcome to Tranås – the heart of Bosch Home Comfort in Sweden
Tranås, beautifully located by the idyllic Lake Sommen and surrounded by forests and nature reserves, is home to Bosch Thermotechnology AB in Sweden. Here, more than 600 associates work in manufacturing and research & development of innovative heating solutions for a sustainable future.
At Bosch, we care about you, our business, and the environment.
We offer more than a job – we help you grow in your career and as a person. Life is about balance, and we support your goals, whether they involve new challenges, development, or time for family and hobbies.
Join a workplace that values individuality, openness, and trust, where you can be yourself and be inspired by diverse perspectives from around the globe.
Join us in Tranås and be part of shaping tomorrow’s energy solutions – in a workplace where innovation meets quality of life.
Here, you’ll find not just a job – but a lifestyle. #LikeABosch

Would you like to work as an psychiatrist in an engaged and supportive team where job satisfaction, collaboration, and professional development are at the heart of everything we do?
Then this position within psychiatric outpatient care in Sweden could be the perfect opportunity for you!
Here, you will find a safe and welcoming workplace with broad multidisciplinary expertise, where they work together to make a real difference for their patients every day.

You will become part of a well-coordinated and skilled team consisting of doctors, psychologists, psychiatric nurses, social workers, occupational therapists, and medical secretaries who work closely together. The clinic also offers mobile services, increasing flexibility and accessibility for patients.
We regularly host students and trainees, which contributes to a dynamic and stimulating learning environment. Our culture is built on mutual respect, teamwork, and continuous improvement. They are also developing digital care solutions to complement traditional consultations.

As a Consultant Psychiatrist, you will be responsible for the assessment, diagnosis, and treatment of patients, in close collaboration with other professionals in the team. An important part of the role also involves cooperation with other healthcare providers and relevant authorities. You will meet patients with various degrees of mental illness, providing both independent assessments and collaborative treatment planning.

Strong communication skills in English and a willingness to learn Swedish

jobs.occupation: ROOF CLEANING TECHNICIAN
jobs.description:
TAKTEAM
SEASONAL 6-MONTH EMPLOYMENT 2027
ROOF CLEANING TECHNICIAN
Would you like to become part of a growing company that offers good opportunities for professional development while contributing to the sustainable maintenance and protection of our customers’ homes?
Then send your application today!
Candidate selection takes place on an ongoing basis.
JOB DESCRIPTION
As a member of our team, you will represent the company to our customers while carrying out the work. Most of the work takes place in different areas of Sweden, and you will be working outdoors, on the tiled roofs of residential properties.
Your duties will include cleaning tiled roofs and facades. This is a varied job involving many different activities and procedures. Overnight travel may also be required.
At the beginning of your employment, you will receive relevant training in the use of high-pressure cleaning equipment and in working at heights. Previous experience in these areas is, of course, an additional advantage.
The work takes place in different areas of Sweden, from the west coast to the east coast. This means that, alongside your work, you will have the opportunity to experience different parts of the country and discover Sweden from a different perspective.
CANDIDATE PROFILE
This is a physically demanding job that requires good physical ability and skill in using your body, hands, and various tools.
You will work in a two-person team responsible for roof cleaning. For this reason, we place great importance on your ability to cooperate and communicate effectively, accept and handle feedback, and, above all, be willing to work hard and pull your weight when needed.
If you have a colleague or friend who is also interested in coming to work in Sweden, we would be happy to know. The possibility of starting together can make it much easier to form a team, as two people usually work together in each team. In this way, if you come together, the team can be ready from the beginning.
Roof cleaning can involve unexpected challenges related to the surface, dimensions, and similar issues. We are therefore looking for someone who is solution-oriented, is not afraid to take initiative, and can suggest creative solutions.
Naturally, we also want you to be flexible, learn quickly, and contribute to creating a good atmosphere within your team, as well as during any contact with customers.
REQUIREMENTS FOR THE POSITION
• Good knowledge of English.
• B or BE driving licence.
ADDITIONAL QUALIFICATIONS
• Good knowledge of Greek.
• Experience using high-pressure washing equipment, carpentry, roof installation/construction, or similar work involving machinery.
• Experience in the construction and assembly of scaffolding.
• Experience in cleaning and painting tiled roofs, as well as cleaning and painting facades.
WHAT DOES IT MEAN TO WORK AS A ROOF CLEANING TECHNICIAN AT TAKTEAM?
• A high level of freedom and responsibility in your work.
• Good opportunities for professional development.
• Variety in your daily work, with different types of tasks for our customers.
• Work in different areas of Sweden.
• Accommodation provided for the duration of your employment with us. Team members share the same apartment/accommodation.
• Statutory insurance coverage.
• Good benefits and working conditions.
• Hourly-paid employment.
• Salary is paid on the 25th of each month and covers the work performed during the previous month.
Working in different areas of Sweden is not only a professional opportunity, but also a way to experience the country, visit different places, and gain new experiences.
If you are hardworking, responsible, cooperative, and eager to develop your skills within a growing company, we would be happy to receive your application!

jobs.occupation: Internship in Project and Production Engineering
jobs.description:
Company Description
Welcome to a world, where your ideas lead to something big. Welcome to Bosch!
Bosch Thermoteknik AB in Tranås develops, manufactures, and sells heat pumps for the European market. We are approximately 650 employees and form part of the large Bosch Group, which consists of approximately 417,000 employees worldwide.
We work with sustainable simplification of everyday life where the focus is on the environment, innovation, and development. In Tranås there is a production unit and a competence and development center. The heat pumps we manufacture draw energy from different sources - the mountain, the water, or the air. We work to constantly be at the forefront and contribute to sustainable energy and a better environment with the goal of creating a simplified everyday life for our customers. In short, we create technology that is "Invented for life". 
Job Description
Your contribution to something big
As a full-time intern in the TEF4 department, you actively contribute to develop and create the conditions for a more efficient production setup to optimize manufacturing.
In this role you will be supporting the local Production Engineering department with daily project management tasks
You will have the opportunity to plan and execute your own production related projects
Evaluating data and creating statistics will allow you to follow up on KPIs of the production
Design parts and create drawings in CAD
Administrative tasks to support the local Production Engineering manager will also be part of your duties
You will be actively participating in the department’s improvement and development, e.g., by moderating workshops

Duration of the internship: 6 months preferably starting in February 2027
Location: on-site in our plant in Tranås, Sweden
Qualifications
What distinguishes you
Currently studying Industrial Engineering or similar (Bachelor or Master of Science)
Previous production-related experience desirable
Good analytical skills, problem-solving mindset, and technical thinking
You thrive in a dynamic work environment – identifying problems, finding solutions and executing them by actively driving your own ideas
Working knowledge in Microsoft Office tools (especially Excel, PowerPoint, Word); experience in other tools (CAD) is a plus
Knowledge in topics like IoT and Industry 4.0 could also be a plus
Open and communicative, ability to approach people easily and to work in a team environment
Fluent verbal and written communication skills in English, Swedish is an advantage

Additional Information
What we offer you
Monetary compensation is included to support you during your internship
We can offer free accommodation in Tranås
To support your well-being, we provide a wellness contribution for use on fitness, sports, or wellness services
We cover your travel costs from your residence to Tranås, making relocation easier for you
You gain valuable experience working within an international company with global connections

Welcome to Tranås – the heart of Bosch Home Comfort in Sweden
Tranås, beautifully located by the idyllic Lake Sommen and surrounded by forests and nature reserves, is home to Bosch Thermotechnology AB in Sweden. Here, more than 600 associates work in manufacturing and research & development of innovative heating solutions for a sustainable future.
At Bosch, we care about you, our business, and the environment.
We offer more than a job – we help you grow in your career and as a person. Life is about balance, and we support your goals, whether they involve new challenges, development, or time for family and hobbies.
Join a workplace that values individuality, openness, and trust, where you can be yourself and be inspired by diverse perspectives from around the globe.
Join us in Tranås and be part of shaping tomorrow’s energy solutions – in a workplace where innovation meets quality of life.
Here, you’ll find not just a job – but a lifestyle. #LikeABosch
